latestVersion.changelog:
wechat-hot-trend 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Provides extraction and summarization of public WeChat pages (announcements, app info, group invites).
- Does not support login, messaging, or accessing private content.
- Handles only publicly accessible share links.
- Outputs key details such as title, author, update time, summary, tags, and links.
- Includes compliance notes on scope and usage restrictions.
